eval_instructions: Test against real .NET (Agent Framework or Semantic Kernel), Node.js (LangChain, OpenAI, or Claude SDK), and Python (Agent Framework, OpenAI, or Google ADK) agent projects. The skill MUST use the a365 CLI (a365 develop list-available, a365 develop add-mcp-servers) to manage ToolingManifest.json — never hand-edit it. The skill is framework-aware: Phase 4 branches on (programmingLanguage, agentStack) from the detection cache. Phase 0B hard-stops for unsupported (lang, stack) pairs (Python LangChain/Claude/CrewAI; Node.js SK/Google ADK) before any CLI commands run. Python Semantic Kernel and Python/.NET Azure AI Foundry are best-effort — the skill installs the package and marks generated code with a 'verify against SDK source' comment because no Microsoft sample is published. Verified against Agent365-{dotnet,python,nodejs} SDK source on 2026-05-21.
